programme.title: Gaddaar
programme.desc: Sunny and Vijay's friendship crumbles when they fall for the same girl. Sunny's jealousy drives him to use Vijay as a pawn, twisting love into a bitter rivalry.

programme.title: Khel
programme.desc: A love triangle between best friends Dev and Rohan and Saanjh. The plot thickens when Rohan is arrested for murder.

programme.title: Tirchhi Topiwale
programme.desc: Opposed lovers, Maya and Raj, find their paths when her parents' chosen suitor falls for someone else.

programme.title: Police Officer
programme.desc: Verma's sons embark on a thrilling quest for vengeance after their father's brutal murder, unleashing a whirlwind of action and drama as they confront their family's enemies.

programme.title: Jis Desh Mein Ganga Rehta Hai
programme.desc: Ganga, an innocent man, is raised by a foster couple in the village. When he is brought back to his family in the city, he struggles to fit into the modern society, and find love and respect.

programme.title: Haathkadi
programme.desc: Suraj Chauhan vows to curb crime after his brother Arun's murder exposed corrupt officials. In prison, he teams with look-alike Rajnikant to uncover true criminals.

programme.title: Hogi Pyar Ki Jeet
programme.desc: Surjit seeks marriage for his pregnant sister, but is humiliated and killed by Thakur. His dying wish is for his sons to marry Thakur's daughters.

programme.title: Tezaab
programme.desc: After His Parents Are Killed, Mahesh'S Life Is Ruined As He Gets Imprisoned And Separated From Mohini, Who Suffers Due To Her Cruel Father. Mahesh Returns To Save Mohini And Settle Old Scores.

programme.title: Zeher
programme.desc: Inspector is thrown into turmoil when a woman mysteriously vanishes, prompting a relentless investigation to uncover dark secrets, hidden motives, and a shocking truth that will change everything.

programme.title: Hum Pyar Tumhi Se Kar Baithe
programme.desc: An upset wife leaves her husband Vikas because of his illegal activities.

programme.title: Hu Tu Tu
programme.desc: In a shocking twist, thugs kidnap the Chief Minister's daughter, and among the captors is her ex. Chaos ensues as the search for her unfolds. Will she be rescued?

programme.title: Naach Govinda Naach
programme.desc: Govinda, an aspiring dancer, lives with his poor mother. In a turn of events, he is given a break to compete with Rocky, a famous dancer in the city.

programme.title: Masoom
programme.desc: A journalist's quest to punish a gangster takes a dark turn when the criminal murders a father and kidnaps his child, forcing a dangerous confrontation between truth and terror.

programme.title: Loafer
programme.desc: Ravi, an unemployed man known for brawling, is wrongly accused of killing a gangster. Abandoned by his family, he must battle alone to clear his name and prove his innocence.

programme.title: Loha (1987)
programme.desc: After a bid to arrest Sher Singh fails, officer Dayal is crippled and his partner Amar's career is sabotaged. When Amar gets another chance to nab Sher Singh, he hires two crooks for the job.

programme.title: Ghayal
programme.desc: Ajay is wrongfully imprisoned for his brother's murder, framed by Balwant Rai. Inside prison, he allies with three convicts and plans a revenge mission against Balwant Rai.

programme.title: Race 3
programme.desc: While planning and executing one of their biggest heists, the members of a criminal family come across some shocking revelations. Thus, their relationships and loyalties are critically tested.

programme.title: Sanam
programme.desc: Gaurav, unloved by his family, joins the army after Narendra's death. He hopes to honor his brother's memory and finally win the respect of his distant father.

programme.title: Dastak
programme.desc: Sharad, mentally unstable, obsessively pursues Miss Universe Sushmita, resorting to harm to those close to her.

programme.title: Saajan Ki Bahon Mein
programme.desc: Sagar and Sapna reunite after years apart, only to find their lives have moved on - he's marrying Kavita, she's engaged to Rakesh. Their hearts face a quiet storm.

programme.title: Hatya
programme.desc: Sagar helps a street boy, unaware of the storm ahead. When the boy's mother is found murdered, Sagar becomes the prime suspect, forced to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Pyar Jhukta Nahin
programme.desc: Preeti returns to her parents' home after facing tensions in her marriage with Ajay, seeking comfort and clarity while navigating the ups and downs of her complicated relationship.

programme.title: Gambler
programme.desc: Though Inspector Dayashanker is lazy, he unwittingly unearths a criminal conspiracy and becomes the pride of his division overnight. However, the local gangsters turn his life into a living nightmare.

programme.title: Karma
programme.desc: A jailer loses his family to a terrorist's cruelty. Fueled by rage, he enlists three condemned men to strike back, forging an unlikely alliance built on pain and purpose.

programme.title: Vanvaas
programme.desc: Deepak, aging and forgetful, seeks his vanished family after Shimla to Benaras. Conmen harm him, but reformers expose organ trafficking and his memory returns.

programme.title: Taqdeer Ka Tamasha
programme.desc: Hindi Feature Film. Cast: Govinda, Gulshan Grover, Jeetendra, Kimi Katkar, Satish Kaushik, Aditya Pancholi.

programme.title: Pukar
programme.desc: Major Jaidev rescues a politician from a notorious terrorist, but his life takes a dangerous turn when the terrorist teams up with his childhood friend Anjali to destroy him.

programme.title: Khuda Kasam
programme.desc: Watch the fight of a brave truck driver and an honest CBI officer against a corrupt politician and his cronies.
